messages:
maria: heads-up, starting onboarding for 'open3b-lite' (3B). need a quant plan: int8 vs fp8 vs gguf hybrids. main constraints: latency SLO 60ms/token, <1.5% quality regression on eval set. anyone around to pair?

leo: I'm free in 20. Let's sketch plan: 1) quick smoke (int8 no calib) 2) per-layer sensitivity sweep 3) per-task evals (qa/chat/ner) 4) calibration with representative prompts 5) choose profile (int8/llm.int8 vs fp8) and run cost model

sufiya: add gguf export step early so infra can load artifacts; also run KV cache perf tests. we saw a 10-15% latency variance on gguf 8-bit loads.

maria: good call. proposed gating: perplexity delta <= 1.2, answer accuracy drop <= 1% on qbench, and embedding cosine >= 0.995 compared to fp32. else fallback to fp8.

leo: draft commands:
```
./tools/quantize --model models/open3b/raw --scheme int8 --calib data/calib_2k.jsonl --out artifacts/open3b-int8.gguf
./tools/eval --model artifacts/open3b-int8.gguf --suites qbench,chat-smoke,ner --report out/reports/int8.json
```

ana: quick note: calibration set should be stratified across length bins and domains. I can assemble 2k examples: trivia, docs, code, dialogs.

quant-bot: run queued: quant-calib/1824082460-started. CI:pr-quant-123

evals-bot: smoke results (int8 no-calib): qbench acc -0.9%, avg latency +1.3x, token cost -58% vs fp32. full sweep scheduled.

sufiya: if int8 fails layer-0/attn heads, try hybrid: int8 for FFN + fp16 for attn. we've used that earlier.

maria: decision tree: if int8 passes gating -> pick int8 gguf + enable batch caching. if marginal -> fp8 best-effort + note cost delta in ticket. if fails -> keep fp16. I'll update the onboarding checklist.

leo: tagging infra for rollout config: @infra-team please add auto-fallback policy to model manifests so requests can degrade to fp8.

ana: I uploaded calib split here: s3://redwood-evals/open3b/calib/2k.jsonl :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all. action items: ana assemble calib (done), leo run per-layer sensitivity, sufiy run hybrid experiments, i'll draft rollout policy. followup in ~2 days.
